title: gelseminum grandiflorum
intro: Gelseminum grandiflorum, commonly known as Chinese Thunder of God Vine, is a plant species within the Gelsemium genus and family Loganiaceae. It has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its health benefits, including its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and calm the nervous system. The therapeutic actions of Gelsemium grandiflorum include its sedative, analgesic, and anti-inflammatory properties, which can help to reduce anxiety, insomnia, and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids such as gelsemine, gelsemidine, and gelsevin, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
